dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: This should be the book that the Director wants...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there, Zhongli. What are you looking at?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}. Always a pleasure. As it happens, the Director asked me to help her purchase some books.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: This is only part of her list. There are some items that are not on sale here. I've already asked the store owner to purchase them.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you read these books, Zhongli?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Not before this, no, but I have read a few recently at Director Hu's urging. Quite interesting, I must say.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Inazuman stories are written in a vastly different style from those of Liyue. I... wouldn't say that either is better. All people have their preferences, after all.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: What of it? I thought the book's depiction of the Shogun's martial prowess was most vivid.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The research the characters conducted into the Musou no Hitotachi was also quite fascinating...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm. It's getting late. I should go deliver these books to Director Hu. Let's meet again sometime.

choices.text: You know, about "Reborn as the Raiden Shogun"...
